subject: Should I close the loop on Redwood discovery with Zenith AI?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@zenith-ai.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.n@zenith-ai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood discovery recap + next steps (quick)

Hi Samir / Priya 1

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and recommended next steps:

- Goal: Reduce inference cost and latency for Zenith's search & summarization pipelines while keeping model quality.
- Technical scope: production text generation, embedding search, and a pilot for private deployment in eu-west.
- Constraints: strict PII controls, SOC2, and SSO integration with Okta.

Next steps I promised:
1) One-pager on Redwood capabilities (attached).
2) Recommended pilot plan (30-day perf & cost baseline) 1I'll send a draft playbook.
3) Intro to our solutions engineer (Aditya) to scope resource needs.

Can you confirm whether security review (SOC2 evidence) is on your side this month or pushed to next quarter? That will help us pick timing for a pilot.

Thanks 1happy to set a short follow-up (15 min) next week if that's useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
m: 415-555-0123
redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (1 page), discovery-notes-template.xlsx

From: Samir Gupta <samir@zenith-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood discovery recap + next steps (quick)

Hi Marissa / Aditya 1

Thanks 1this is helpful. Quick Qs from our side:
- Can you share an expected ballpark for pilot cost for 30 days (dev + staged traffic)?
- We will need SOC2 artifacts and a basic data mapping for the pilot. Can your compliance team provide that?

We're heads-down this week but should be able to carve time for a 15-min call next Tue/Thu. Priya will lead security; copying her.

Regards,
Samir
Head of ML Ops | Zenith AI
samir@zenith-ai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@zenith-ai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check-in on pilot timing

Hi Samir 1

Just checking in 1any update on whether security review lands this month? If the priority slipped, totally understand 1let me know and I can adjust the pilot timeline and internal resources.

If helpful I can also share a short ballpark estimate for a 30-day pilot (GPU hours + engineer support). Happy to do a 10-min call to walk through.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@zenith-ai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Closing the loop 1 should I close this out?

Hi Samir 1

Haven't heard back so I'll close the file after this note. If Zenith wants to revisit, we're happy to re-open and run the pilot when the timing is right.

If the priority is different now, would you mind replying with one of the options below?

- Still interested 1 schedule pilot in Aug/Sep
- Interested but delayed 1 ping me when security review is done
- Not a fit 1 please close the loop

If I don't hear back, I'll archive this and circle back in three months.

Thanks for your time 1 and appreciate the candidness.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: zenith-discovery-notes.docx
